text:
Maya (People Ops): Heads up — we have a 3:00pm visitor: Lina (artist) bringing a hanging mobile + 2 fragile boxes labeled ‘installation’. Also bringing her mom who prefers a low-sensory spot. Front desk kiosk seems flaky. Can someone print manual badges and reserve the quiet nook by the window? Thanks :pray:

Sam (Front Desk): Noted. Kiosk showing 502 on my end. I can print manual badges. Where do you want the boxes stored until the install?

DeliveryBot: Courier ETA ~2:55pm, recipient name: Lina, package count: 2 (fragile). Driver note: please sign if no one at desk.

Jordan: I can meet the courier. I’ll take the boxes to Supply Closet A (under the stairs). I’ll mark them fragile.

Ava: I'll put a 'quiet space — please keep voices low' sign on the window table. Do we want a visitor badge + photo or a vendor pass?

Maya (People Ops): Visitor badge + photo, temporary access for the day. Please capture a quick photo on the kiosk fallback flow. If kiosk is down, use manual badge workflow below.

Sam (Front Desk): Manual badge printing (if kiosk down):
```
# quick manual badge print flow
open /opt/badge_tools/create_badge.sh --name "Lina" --role "Visitor" --photo /tmp/lina.jpg
lp -d Badge_Printer /tmp/badge_Lina.pdf
```
I'll also toggle 'Visitor' network access for a one-day token.

BadgePrinterBot: ALERT — paper feed jam detected at 2:57pm. See status LED blinks 3x.

Sam (Front Desk): Cleared jam, restarted printer. Printing badges now. :white_check_mark:

Jordan: Courier checked in at 2:58, signed (Jordan). Boxes in Supply Closet A, labeled and wrapped. I left a sticky note: "Lina — fragile, do not stack".

Ava: Seating poll for Lina's mom — where should we set her up? Reply with emoji:
:couch: Window nook (low light)
:seat: Armchair in kitchen corner

Maya (People Ops): I'll go with :couch: window nook — quieter and closer to front desk.

Jordan: :couch: (moved armchair cushions to make it cozier)

Sam (Front Desk): Lina arrived 2:59, checked ID, badge printed, mom seated in window nook. All good.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks everyone — Lina’s dropped off a tiny spare mobile hook in box 2 (labelled "installer: hang on north beam"). Jordan, can you note that in the install checklist?

Jordan: Added to checklist and pinged Eng Install channel.

Maya (People Ops): Closing thread. Appreciated the quick turn-around :raised_hands:
